blocks.html: OPM icons Jim Paredes and Boboy Garovillo of Apo Hiking perform at Robinsons Galleria Ortigas on Sunday, September 11 at 5pm. The ‘young once’ and the ‘young at heart’ will surely be entertained with the line-up that is in store for this afternoon OPM hits. All-time favorites and classic hits “Yakap sa Dilim”, “Awit ng Barkada”, “Blue Jeans” among others will be performed live by Jim and Boboy. Expect to be included in their line-up their hits like “Batang Bata Ka Pa”, “Panalangin” and so much more. Know more about this and other upcoming events by following Robinsons Malls in Facebook: Robinsons Malls; Twitter: @RobinsonsMalls; and Instagram: @robinsonsmallsofficial or visit www.robinsonsmalls.com
